title: Create the ork logo
lead: Owner asked for a logo (2026-10-20). Interview answers: an agent drafts hand-written SVG candidates and the owner picks one; the logo is used in the README header, the TUI header or splash, the ork --version and ork doctor banner, and a favicon or repository social image. This slice lands the chosen logo and the README header; S54 uses it in the terminal. The owner chose (2026-10-20): the 'New: ring root, teal letters, coloured slices' option, a ring (not a solid disc) for the o, lockup B (lanes off the o), slices centred under the letters. The finished SVGs already exist in .scratch/candidates/6-tree-ring/ (lockup-b.svg and mark.svg); this slice copies them, adds the test and the README header.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: ork has no mark. The README, the repository page and the terminal all want one, and the owner wants to choose it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- assets/logo.svg: copy .scratch/candidates/6-tree-ring/lockup-b.svg unchanged (the word ork with the teal ring as the o and three lanes to three slices, viewBox 0 0 200 144). assets/logo-square.svg: copy .scratch/candidates/6-tree-ring/mark.svg unchanged (64 grid square mark for a favicon or social image). Read them from the main checkout by absolute path: /Users/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork/.scratch/candidates/6-tree-ring/. Do not add the other drafts or any assets/candidates directory to the repo.
- assets/logo_test.go: new test-only Go package (package assets, no non-test Go file, stdlib only, SPDX header). It reads the two SVGs and ../README.md.
- README.md: the logo at the very top, above the '# ork' heading.
- No change to docs unless one names the logo. No new dependency, no raster file, no font, no script, no generator.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- assets/logo.svg and assets/logo-square.svg parse as XML with encoding/xml, the root is svg with an xmlns of http://www.w3.org/2000/svg and a viewBox (200x144 and 64x64), they have a non-empty title and desc, and they contain no script, foreignObject, image, use, style or href/xlink:href element or attribute and no http or https URL other than the xmlns.
- Reads on light and dark: every fill and stroke colour is one of #6ee7d2 teal, #f4efe7 cream, #3b82f6, #8b5cf6, #ea580c (or none); no shape covers the whole viewBox (no background); every cream-filled shape lies inside a coloured-filled shape (the slice edge), so no cream shape stands alone on a light page.
- Both files have the same three slice colours and the same teal.
- README.md: the first non-blank line is an HTML img tag whose src is assets/logo.svg, with a non-empty alt that starts with ork, and a width attribute; the '# ork' heading follows it.
- The files carry no copyright text beyond the repository licence (no 'copyright' or '(c)' in them). The owner chose the design on 2026-10-20.
